name: documentation-quality-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal documentation improvement actions based on content data, user feedback, and historical improvement outcomes

options.description: Add missing sections to improve completeness
Update existing content to improve accuracy and freshness
Improve readability through formatting, examples, and clearer language
Add practical examples and step-by-step tutorials
Restructure for better navigation and user experience

evaluation_factors: Documentation completeness percentage, last updated date, and content freshness
User feedback scores, support ticket volume, and common confusion points
Historical success rates for each improvement action in similar documentation scenarios
Time sensitivity and potential impact on users during documentation improvement process
Risk of introducing new issues with more invasive documentation approaches
